member.name: M:SchemaConversion.Orchestration.PathValidator.SessionIdPattern
member.remarks:
Pattern:
^[a-zA-Z0-9\\-_]+$
Explanation:
○ Match if at the beginning of the string.
○ Match a character in the set [-0-9A-Z_a-z] atomically at least once.
○ Match if at the end of the string or if before an ending newline.

member.name: M:SchemaConversion.Orchestration.PathValidator.FileNameSegmentPattern
member.remarks:
Pattern:
^[a-zA-Z0-9\\-_.]+$
Explanation:
○ Match if at the beginning of the string.
○ Match a character in the set [-.0-9A-Z_a-z] atomically at least once.
○ Match if at the end of the string or if before an ending newline.
